reason: The README clearly describes a conversation utility for editing messages, branching session versions, rerolling or retrying turns, and navigating their timeline; retries may re-execute agent and tool chains, so the capability risk is elevated.

summaries.zh: 用于编辑对话消息、创建分支会话、重掷或重试回合，并通过时间线查看及切换版本。
summaries.en: A conversation utility for editing messages, creating branched sessions, rerolling or retrying turns, and viewing or switching versions through a timeline.

capabilities: Edits settled user and assistant message content
Creates branched session versions instead of rewriting history
Rerolls or retries selected conversation turns
Can preserve later user inputs while re-executing assistant and tool chains
Provides a Timeline UI with version navigation and undo/redo controls
Exposes HTTP endpoints for reading and applying message-edit operations
